prompt: I have a design library at design/system.lib.pen with Button and Input components. Add a sign-up form to my open .pen file using those components. Explain the tools you'd call and why.

assertions.text: Calls get_editor_state first to verify host and inspect the open document's imports field
Adds the library to the document's imports (e.g. via U op on document root with imports: { ds: './design/system.lib.pen' }) when not already imported
Reads the library to discover available reusable components (batch_get with a cross-document pattern)
Instantiates Button and Input via ref nodes (type: 'ref', ref: '<componentId>') NOT by recreating them from primitives
Uses descendants for instance-level overrides (label text, placeholders, etc.)
Mentions screenshot verification after the form lands
States a brief plan before issuing batch_design ops
Notes that the imports path is relative to the importing .pen, not the project root
